draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41 (Corvex A2, fp16) and T1.r2.lat=118 (Corvex A1, fp32, from Ruiz-Hale et al.). The claim states the numbers correctly and "faster" is supported by 41<118. However, the latencies were measured on different hardware/precision, which the claim omits; this is a scope caveat but the factual comparison is accurate as stated.
